reviews.text:
I couldn’t be happier with the care Lorna gave to Baileys during her 6-night stay. ❤️ She was looked after with so much love, care and professionalism, which gave me great peace of mind while I was away.

Lorna also kept me updated throughout her stay and sent me photos of Baileys, which I really appreciated. It was lovely to see her happy and know she was in such good hands.

I would highly recommend Lorna and River Cottage Cattery to anyone looking for a safe, caring and professional place for their cat. I will definitely be contacting Lorna first for Baileys’ future stays!

Thank you so much, Lorna, for taking such wonderful care of my little Baileys! 🐾❤️

My cat recently stayed at River Cottage Cattery, I was very worried putting her in as she is a very independent cat who comes and goes when she likes! Unfortunately I was getting house renovations so she had to go. The owner was very flexible, and allowed me to put back the start day of the boarding as the builders were delayed starting.
I was very impressed with the facility, it's a lovely place, all the cats seem happy and well looked after. My cat was perfectly happy when I went to pick her up after 4 weeks there. She came home like she had never been away. No issues whatsoever with this cattery, would definitely use in future.
Thankyou Ian much appreciate the review

Fantastic cattery, Lorna was so welcoming to my Meowses and she made the whole experience super easy for everyone despite my initial nerves at leaving my kitty with anyone! Would highly recommend the River Cottage Cattery!
Thankyou so much Maria for your review

It was my first time leaving my cat on his own and I was worried about having to do this but he was so well looked after and I could tell that Lorna and Brian really care for the cats in their care and know them all and their little personalities, couldn't recommend enough.
Great place, my cat Jeremy was really well looked after and I had great peace of mind as it was his first time away from home.
Great place. Our cat was well looked after.
Thankyou Liam review much appreciated 😉 Lorna  …

Such a lovely cattery ,  The owners are incredibly friendly and welcoming, creating a calm and caring environment from the moment you arrive. It’s clear they genuinely love cats and go the extra mile to make each guest feel at home. Our cat Enzo settles in quickly and seems relaxed and content throughout his stay—he even came back purring and playful! Highly recommend to anyone looking for a safe, happy place for their cat.
Amazing cattery. Highly recommend and have been using for many many years.
Gorgeous cattery. Cats very well cared for. Highly recommend x
Amazing cattery. I have never seen our cats as unaffected by being in a cattery. Highly recommend
Our cats are always well taken care of here.

I would give ten stars if it was available. We left our 2 cats, Bailey and Ollie in with Lorna and Brian and I have to say they were amazing. We were nervous to leave our cats anywhere because we had a past bad experience with our dogs in a kennel, so we really did our homework and visited a lot of catteries. When we visited river cottage, the first thing we noticed was the fresh scent and extra large space provided for your pet. Even though you are welcome to bring what ever you want your cats to have, River Cottage do actually provide everything you could need. The spaces have cat trees and lots of toys to play with. Lorna and Brian are so patient and take lots of time to answer any questions you have and happily, keep you updated how they were getting on, which gave us absolute confidence we picked the right cattery for our two. Nothing was too much or any inconvenience for Lorna and Brian. When my pets came home, they were happy and content and settled back in right away. We'll be using river cottage forever. Thank you so much for everything guys, we hugely appreciate it 🥰
